title: Arjun Badola and Dikshit Hegde win QIF India 2026
headline: India 2026
summary: Arjun Badola and Dikshit Hegde have won the Qualcomm Innovation Fellowship India 2026 for their proposal on transparent 3D Gaussian splatting, advised by Prof. Shanmuganathan Raman.
proposal: Frequency-Adaptive Prior Supervision for Transparent 3D Gaussian Splatting
proposalLines:
Frequency-Adaptive Prior Supervision
for Transparent 3D Gaussian Splatting
caption: Congratulations to Arjun Badola and Dikshit Hegde on winning the Qualcomm Innovation Fellowship India 2026. Their proposal, ‘Frequency-Adaptive Prior Supervision for Transparent 3D Gaussian Splatting’, is advised by Prof. Shanmuganathan Raman at IIT Gandhinagar.
illustrationDescription: The torus is a doughnut-shaped surface. The Gaussian version uses overlapping elliptical contours, the low-poly version uses triangular faces, and the simple version uses a wireframe. These are conceptual illustrations, not results from the awarded project.

title: Ayush Shrivastava and Rohit Narayanan selected for TCS PhD fellowships
headline: PhD fellowships
summary: Ayush Shrivastava and Rohit Narayanan have been selected for the TCS Research Scholar Program, Cycle 20, with fellowships effective 1 July 2026.
caption: Congratulations to Ayush Shrivastava and Rohit Narayanan on their selection for the TCS Research Scholar Program, Cycle 20. Ayush is advised by Prof. Nipun Batra and Prof. Mayank Goel; Rohit is advised by Prof. Balagopal Komarath. The fellowships are effective 1 July 2026.
